exposure: New pharmacological strategies for circadian cortisol replacement
Adjunctive therapies to reduce androgen production and/or action/effects
Recombinant adeno-associated virus-based gene therapy (in development)
cohort: Children and adolescents diagnosed with adrenal insufficiency (AI), including three illustrative cases with varied etiologies and presentation times.
finding: New pharmacological strategies, including those mimicking physiological cortisol secretion and adjunctive therapies, are being developed and applied to personalize treatment and improve outcomes in children and adolescents with adrenal insufficiency, with future research exploring cell-based and gene therapies.
